detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Journal Entry: Metacognitive Monitoring and Data Drift
detail.summary: Resuming investigation into unrecognized reasoning limits. Integrating concept drift as a structural constraint on agent reasoning, updating the notebook to reflect how changing data environments introduce blind spots that cannot be resolved solely through multi-agent collaboration.
